This mechanism is supported by the presence of a direct interaction between Amifostine and Alppl2, as well as the involvement of Alpl2 in alkaline phosphatase activity. The evidence suggests that Amifostine may act as a modulator of alkaline phosphatase, possibly by inhibiting its activity or altering its subunit composition. The integration of these findings supports a plausible mechanism by which Amifostine could interact with Alpl, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact role of Amifostine in this process.
